title: Empty text when playing any XP game

posts.author: Mr_Fish007
posts.body:
When I play any game that is made with RPG Maker XP all text is invisible, no error messages. I have tried reinstalling games and the rtp itself (from this site) but it didn't help
What can I try to do?
(I play on Windows 10 so the problem is probably not wine, but my PC does have linux default)
